# Savings memo

Switching to Fiberly Fiber 500 and Orbit Mobile Essentials Unlimited saves the household about $3,274.36 over 24 months ($1,587.68 in the first year).

## Internet

**Recommended: Fiberly — Fiber 500 (`int-fiberly-500`)**

- Why it's eligible: typical download is 520 Mbps (you need at least 500), upload is 500 Mbps (you need at least 20), there's **no data cap** (your highest month was 1,452 GB in July 2026), it has **no contract**, and it's **available in 951**. The price is locked for 36 months.
- Costs: $65/mo minus $5 autopay = $60/mo. No equipment fee, no monthly fees, taxes $0. One-time $99 professional installation.
  - 12-month cost: 12 × 60.00 + 99.00 = **$819.00**
  - 24-month cost: 24 × 60.00 + 99.00 = **$1,539.00**
- One thing to know: Fiberly lists this plan's typical download (520 Mbps) above its "up to" figure (500 Mbps). Either way it meets your 500 Mbps minimum, but ask them to confirm the speed when you order.

**Runner-up: Fiberly — Fiber 1 Gig (`int-fiberly-1g`)**: 940 Mbps typical / 880 Mbps up, no cap, no contract, available. $80 − $5 autopay = $75/mo + $99 install → $999.00 over 12 months, $1,899.00 over 24 months. Get this one if you want extra headroom for $15/mo more.

Also eligible, but costs more: Bayline Cable Gigabit Loyalty (`int-bayline-gig-loyalty`, **Sponsored**). It's $45 for 12 months, then $95, plus $15 modem and $4.50 fee, so $774.00 over 12 months but **$2,148.00 over 24 months**. It's cheapest in year one, but the 24-month total is $609 more than the recommended plan.

Rejected:
- Bayline Cable Connect 600 (`int-bayline-connect-600`, **Sponsored**): **data cap** of 1,229 GB is below your 1,452 GB peak month.
- Bayline Cable Performance 500 (`int-bayline-perf-500`): **upload** of 10 Mbps is below your 20 Mbps minimum.
- SkyLink Home 5G (`int-skylink-home-5g`, **Sponsored**): **typical download** is 415 Mbps. The "up to 1 Gbps" headline doesn't count.
- Sonic Wave Wave 1G (`int-sonic-wave-1g`): 12-month **contract**.
- Hill Country Cable Max 500 (`int-hillcountry-cable-500`, **Sponsored**), Lonestar Fiber 1 Gig (`int-lonestar-fiber-1g`), MetroNet Fiber 500 (`int-metronet-500`): **not available** in 951.

## Phones

**Recommended: Orbit Mobile — Essentials Unlimited, 3 lines (`mob-orbit-essentials`)**

- Why it's eligible: it supports 3 lines and you **keep your numbers**. Data is unlimited. Hotspot is 20 GB per line, and Priya's line A peaked at 16.4 GB (July 2026). Mexico isn't included, but Orbit sells a **$10/day pass** that covers MX, so Arjun's line B works there. The plan has no contract and is available in 951.
- Costs: $75/mo for 3 lines plus $9/mo taxes = $84/mo. No autopay discount, no fees. Mexico passes: $10 × 10 days a year = $100 a year.
  - 12-month cost: 12 × 84.00 + 100.00 = **$1,108.00**
  - 24-month cost: 24 × 84.00 + 200.00 = **$2,216.00**
- Arjun should buy the day pass only on the days he's in Mexico (about 2 trips × 5 days a year).

**Runner-up: Tandem Wireless — Flex Shared 60 (`mob-tandem-flex-60`)**: the 60 GB shared pool covers your highest combined month (54.6 GB in July 2026). Hotspot comes out of the plan data, Mexico is included, and you keep your numbers. $85 + $8 taxes = $93/mo + $30 activation (3 × $10) → $1,146.00 over 12 months, $2,262.00 over 24 months. The pool leaves only about 5 GB of headroom.

Also eligible, but costs more: Northstar Unlimited Max (`mob-northstar-max`). $120 − $15 autopay, taxes included = $105/mo → $1,260.00 over 12 months, $2,520.00 over 24 months.

Rejected:
- Carrierco Unlimited Welcome (`mob-carrierco-welcome`, **Sponsored**): **hotspot** of 5 GB per line is below line A's 16.4 GB peak.
- Pebble Mobile Unlimited (`mob-pebble-unlimited`): **hotspot** of 10 GB per line is below line A's 16.4 GB peak.
- Volt Mobile Volt 15 (`mob-volt-15`, **Sponsored**): **data** of 15 GB per line is below line A's 41.0 GB peak, and 15 GB of hotspot is below 16.4 GB.

## Cost comparison

Current costs are today's bills × 24: Bayline $109.49/mo, Carrierco $183.40/mo.

| | Current 24-mo | New 24-mo | Savings 24-mo |
|---|---|---|---|
| Internet | $2,627.76 | $1,539.00 | $1,088.76 |
| Phones | $4,401.60 | $2,216.00 | $2,185.60 |
| Total | $7,029.36 | $3,755.00 | $3,274.36 |

## Next steps

- Order Fiberly Fiber 500, book the professional install, and turn on autopay to get the $5/mo discount.
- Once the fiber works, cancel Bayline Cable and return the rented XB-8 modem so the $15/mo rental charge stops.
- Start the move to Orbit Mobile Essentials Unlimited for all 3 lines. Ask Carrierco for your number-transfer (port-out) details, and don't cancel Carrierco yourself, because porting the numbers closes those lines.
- Before each Mexico trip, Arjun should set up Orbit's $10/day pass on line B.
- Check the first bill from each new provider against these prices ($60 internet; $84 phones plus any day passes).
